Record Class GameState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.state.GameState
Record Components:
currentEra - era currently being played
currentRound - round number currently being played
phase - current game phase
currentPlayerId - id of the active player, or null when none
players - per player snapshots
board - snapshot of the central board
scores - final score breakdown, or null while the game is still running
skipAllowed - whether the active player can legally skip the draw
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record GameState(Era currentEra, int currentRound, GamePhase phase, String currentPlayerId, List<PlayerState> players, BoardState board, List<ScoreEntry> scores, boolean skipAllowed) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable serializable snapshot of the whole game. Carries the era, the round, the current phase, the active player and the snapshot of every player and of the board. Final scores are only attached after the game has ended; clients can detect this via scores() returning a non null value.

    • GameState

      public GameState(Era currentEra, int currentRound, GamePhase phase, String currentPlayerId, List<PlayerState> players, BoardState board, List<ScoreEntry> scores, boolean skipAllowed)
      Builds a snapshot for the terminal phase, attaching the final scores. Use () non null to detect that this snapshot carries the end of game score breakdown.
      Parameters:
      currentEra - era at the end of the match
      currentRound - round number at the end of the match
      phase - current game phase (typically GamePhase.ENDED)
      currentPlayerId - id of the active player, or null when none
      players - per player snapshots
      board - snapshot of the central board
      scores - final score breakdown
      skipAllowed - whether the active player can skip the draw
